result.reason: The added clause largely tracks the preferred position: it is mutual, includes the USD 1 million/12-month-fee cap, excludes indirect and consequential damages, and contains all required uncapped carve-outs. However, the fee lookback is measured from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the payment-obligation exception applies only to payments under Sections 3 and 4.2 rather than clearly covering all Customer payment obligations. Those operative deviations prevent full compliance with the preferred position, and the USD 1 million floor means it does not precisely implement the fallback either. The amendment is otherwise targeted, preserves unrelated terms, and is professionally drafted.
